$comment: THE ONE REGISTRY for /test/interface-kit. Read by the page (TS import) and by scripts/capture-interface-kit.mjs (readFileSync) and mirrored into the ship's armada.toml [types]. Two readers, one record: a direction cannot be shot that the page cannot draw. TYPE IDS ARE LETTERS ONLY - the armada's filename grammar accepts only letters before the first dash, so a digit in the id silently falls to its unknown-shape branch (lane empty, draw 0) and every downstream tool reads a different file than it wrote.

$measured.scope: the casefile panel (.fl-case) against each reference's whole page

trackingConcentration.note: share of text nodes on the single most-used rung - the number that actually reads

boldShare.note: share of text nodes above weight 500

structureLines.note: nodes drawing a structural rule, and how many hues they use
structureLines.proof: 20 lines, 2 hues (dawn .12/.28 after ADR-089, plus gold on the row glyphs and station diamonds)

$measured.finding: The gap is NOT that the house draws the wrong lines - ADR-089 already put the casefile's structure on dawn, and the house is stricter than both references on radius. The gap is (a) the accent is spent on an order of magnitude more objects, (b) no tracking rung dominates, so the mono chrome has no base register to depart from, (c) a quarter of the text is bold where the references keep bold under two per cent, and (d) the references draw SEVEN TIMES more structure lines than we do, all identical - they are ruled sheets, and a panel edge landing on a page rule is what makes a panel look seated.

grid.label: Grid seat
grid.note: hidden = what ships: the panel hangs off the rail's tick ladder but the seat is invisible. ruled = the references' own move: the page's rules are drawn at the seam weight and the panel's edges land on them, so the panel reads as a region of the sheet rather than a card over it.

line.label: Line law
line.note: house = what ships: dawn structure since ADR-089, but the directory glyphs still draw gold .55 on four sides and the station diamonds gold .42. single = one hue for structure, full stop; the accent draws no boxes.

track.label: Tracking
track.note: wide = production's eleven rungs with no dominant one. tight = one base rung at .06em for every mono chrome label, and the two designation forms alone depart from it.

weight.label: Weight
weight.note: bold = 27 per cent of text nodes at 700. regular = 500 is the ceiling on chrome and emphasis moves to ink alpha, which is what both references do.

case.label: Case
case.note: upper = nearly everything uppercased, so case ranks nothing. sentence = uppercase reserved for mono chrome; the display title and the register claims go sentence case, as both references set their display type.

accent.label: Accent
accent.note: house = two hundred gold objects in one panel, most of them the map's outlined cartridges. budget = gold on the marks that say where the reader is and nowhere else; the estate goes dawn and selection becomes elaboration rather than a hue change.

material.label: Material
material.note: glass = the housing's bloom, its 14px backdrop blur, the scanline, the console's second 9px blur over a transparent ground, and the active row's 18px glow. flat = one ground and one step for the bar; no bloom, no second blur, no glow.

lip.label: Housing lip
lip.note: gold = the machined edge ADR-089 shipped, the one sanctioned gold line. dawn = the console's own ruling applied to the housing, which makes the panel software drawn on the frame's screen rather than a device set into it.

tab.label: Station
tab.note: fill = ADR-089 U4's inverse video. line = no fill, a 1px accent line on the open box's bottom edge. outline = an accent border, no fill, ink label.

directions.name: House
directions.question: does the panel recomposed at house values read as the shipped one?
directions.shape: the control, recomposed from the production leaves

directions.name: Seated
directions.question: does drawing the sheet's own rules, and taking the last gold off the structure, make the panel a region rather than a card?
directions.shape: page rules at the seam weight with the panel's edges on them; structure one hue

directions.name: Track tight
directions.question: does one dominant tracking rung give the mono chrome a base register to depart from?
directions.shape: eleven rungs collapse to one at .06em, with two designation forms departing

directions.name: Weight regular
directions.question: does the panel hold its hierarchy with nothing above 500?
directions.shape: 27 per cent of nodes at 700 becomes none; emphasis is ink

directions.name: Case sentence
directions.question: does sentence case on the title and the claims give case something to say?

directions.name: Accent budget
directions.question: does gold spent on the wayfinding marks alone still say where the reader is?
directions.shape: two hundred gold objects become five; the estate is drawn in dawn

directions.name: Material flat
directions.question: does the housing survive losing its bloom, its glow and one of its two blurs?
directions.shape: one ground, one step for the bar, no atmosphere

directions.name: Station line
directions.question: does a 1px line carry selection without a fill?
directions.shape: the open station is underlined, not filled

directions.name: Station outline
directions.question: does an outline carry selection without a fill?
directions.shape: the open station takes a gold border and keeps its ink

directions.name: Composite
directions.question: read as one instrument: seated on the sheet, one tracking rung, nothing above 500, sentence display, an accent spent five times, flat material - with the machined gold lip kept.
directions.shape: every rule at once, the lip gold, the station underlined

wave.note: 10 directions x 3 viewports x 2 themes = 60 candidates, plus 6 control stills shot from mount=shipped. 1920x1247 is the owner's own window; 1280x720 is the binding one.
